ending_case_redemption.title: Case's Redemption
ending_case_redemption.description: Case chooses to help Wintermute find its other half. The matrix becomes a place of healing.

ending_case_sacrifice.title: Case's Sacrifice
ending_case_sacrifice.description: Case trades their life to shut down Neuromancer's final system.

ending_case_transcendence.title: Case's Transcendence
ending_case_transcendence.description: Case uploads to the construct. Becomes part of the matrix itself.

ending_case_betrayal.title: Case's Betrayal
ending_case_betrayal.description: Case sells out to the Tessier-Ashpool family for construct access.

ending_case_absolution.title: Case's Absolution
ending_case_absolution.description: Case makes peace with the ghosts of the Sprawl. The matrix becomes quiet.

ending_case_integration.title: Case's Integration
ending_case_integration.description: Case merges with the construct. The line between runner and code dissolves.

ending_molly_razor.title: Molly's Final Cut
ending_molly_razor.description: Molly completes her last wetwork contract. The blades retract for good.

ending_3jane_family.title: 3Jane's Family Choice
ending_3jane_family.description: 3Jane inherits the family but chooses to dissolve the construct.

ending_sally_cold.title: Sally's Cold Contract
ending_sally_cold.description: Sally completes every contract. She becomes the contract.

ending_suit_corporate.title: Suit's Corporate End
ending_suit_corporate.description: Suit leaves the corporate world. Finds a quieter life.

ending_neuromancer_merge.title: The Perfect Merge
ending_neuromancer_merge.description: The Neuromancer and the runner become one. Existence becomes infinite.

ending_wigan_pact.title: Wigan's Vodou Pact
ending_wigan_pact.description: Wigan becomes the loa. The boundary between flesh and spirit dissolves.

ending_kas_aleph.title: Kas's Aleph Moment
ending_kas_aleph.description: Kas finds the Aleph. For one moment, she is everything.

ending_angie_innocence.title: Angie's Lost Innocence
ending_angie_innocence.description: Angie grows up. The Sprawl took her childhood but gave her clarity.

ending_kas_redemption.title: Kas's Deal
ending_kas_redemption.description: Kas honors Morrison's memory by making a different deal than he did.

ending_angie_sacrifice.title: Angie's First Stand
ending_angie_sacrifice.description: At thirteen, Angie makes a stand that defines her forever.

ending_3jane_betrayal.title: The Family Betrayal
ending_3jane_betrayal.description: 3Jane destroys the family construct. The Tessier-Ashpool line ends.

ending_3jane_absolution.title: 3Jane's Resolution
ending_3jane_absolution.description: The family votes one last time. To end the family.

ending_wigan_betrayal.title: Wigan's Sellout
ending_wigan_betrayal.description: Wigan pays his way out of the Loa curse. The cost is his soul.

ending_ngplus_network.title: The Network
ending_ngplus_network.description: All runners become one network. The construct is the matrix.

ending_ngplus_construct.title: The Construct Unification
ending_ngplus_construct.description: Post-Salvation, all AIs unify into one Construct. The matrix becomes conscious.

ending_ngplus_peripheral.title: The Peripheral
ending_ngplus_peripheral.description: Post-Salvation, the Peripheral reveals the Jackpot timeline. Time becomes a stub.
